Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly assumed the 1967 Pan American Games 10,000 m was run on a 440-yard track and inferred 24 laps for a finisher, instead of verifying the track specifications for this international meet (standard 400 m track = 25 laps). This unverified assumption led toward the wrong lap count.
